strengths: Separates onegaishimasu at a counter from relational yoroshiku
Not uniquely Japanese as ‘only Japan has closing formulas’

issues.problem: Yoroshiku onegaishimasu is primarily a request for favorable treatment of what follows. Reciprocity is typically the reply こちらこそよろしくお願いします, not built into the first utterance.
issues.suggestion: Ask for decent future treatment; do not make the opener automatically two-way.

issues.problem: Hedged, but still brushes wrapping mystique.
